theater: 奇萊平原達固湖灣與加禮宛社

battle.name: 達固湖灣戰爭
battle.theater: 奇萊平原達固湖灣與加禮宛社
battle.brief: 光緒年間清廷推行開山撫番，兵線推抵奇萊平原。一八七七年冬，臺灣總兵吳光亮在卑南、水尾一線佈下前哨，翌年總兵孫開華率擢勝軍、鎮海中營等兩千餘人乘輪船抵花蓮港，先以火攻燒穿達固湖灣的刺竹林，再分兵夾擊加禮宛社，奇萊平原上最堅固的兩處堡壘相繼失守。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰的兩方，一方是清帝國在臺灣的鎮戍體系。福建巡撫吳贊誠以督辦臺灣軍務的身分居中節制，臺灣總兵吳光亮掌花蓮以北至卑南一線的東路防線，總兵孫開華領擢勝軍一營、鎮海中營七哨與新設海字營四哨，另由福靖新右營兩哨屯紮新城鵲子埔。兵源是營勇與綠營兵丁，並僱用熟悉山徑的番社嚮導；軍械與火藥由福州船政局、江南製造總局供給，食糧與彈藥經基隆、打狗搭海船運抵花蓮港，再由挑夫、牛車轉運入山。另一方是奇萊平原上的達固湖灣撒奇萊雅族，與其盟友加禮宛人（噶瑪蘭族），部落據點在立霧溪以南、木瓜溪以北，勢力遍及平原中部；大頭目古穆·巴力克掌達固湖灣，加禮宛社主戰的達甫·瓦努為樞紐。周邊的荳蘭、薄薄等社在清軍與撒奇萊雅之間觀望，竹木番與七腳川社阿美族則被清廷徵用為攻擊達固湖灣與加禮宛的協攻主力。這種以番制番的部署，是清軍能以有限兵力壓制奇萊平原的前提。
countriesEn: The two sides were, on one hand, the Qing garrison system in Taiwan. Fujian Governor Wu Zan-ch'eng sat at the centre as the official supervising military affairs in Taiwan; Taiwan's brigadier-general Wu Guang-liang held the eastern line from Hualien north to Beinan; and brigadier-general Sun Kai-hua led one battalion of the Chuo-sheng Army, seven detachments of the Chen-hai Central Camp and four newly raised detachments of the Hai-tzu Camp, while two detachments of the Fu-ching New Right Camp garrisoned Chiu-tzu-pu at Hsin-cheng. The soldiers were garrison levies and Green Standard troops, with local tribal guides hired to lead them over the mountain paths; arms and powder came from the Foochow Arsenal and the Kiangnan Arsenal, and food and ammunition were carried by sea from Keelung and Takou to Hualien harbour, then shifted inland by porters, draught animals and carts. On the other hand stood the Sakizaya people of Takobowan on the Cholan plain, allied with the Kaliawan, that is the Kavalan, people, whose settlements lay between the Liwu and Mugua rivers and whose strength covered the middle of the plain; the great headman Komod Pazik held Takobowan, and Dafu Wanu, the war leader of the Kaliawan community, was the other pivotal figure. Neighbouring communities such as Tou-lan and Po-po watched from the sidelines, while the Truku and the Seven-Leg Amis of Chiu-chiao-chuan were conscripted by the Qing as auxiliaries against Takobowan and Kaliawan. It was this arrangement of using one tribe to control another that made it possible for the Qing army to hold down the Cholan plain with a limited number of men.
people: 清方主導這場戰事的是三個人。福建巡撫吳贊誠起初同情加禮宛的處境，主張查明起因、先行安撫，等到加派鎮海軍、衝突重燃，又有參將文毓麟等十人遇害，才轉而主張武力鎮壓，並把剿辦的實際指揮交給總兵孫開華。臺灣總兵吳光亮自一八七六年接任張其光之後整飭東路，先在卑南、水尾、馬太鞍與吳全城一線佈置駐兵，戰事中負責從南面竹林攻入的最後一擊。孫開華原定由美崙山進攻加禮宛，九月初五在美崙山探勘時遭加禮宛人襲擊、死傷數名，遂改為先攻達固湖灣以孤立加禮宛；他表面上親率主力趨向加禮宛，實際卻遣參將胡德興、吳立貴、同知朱上泮、都司李英與劉洪順率精兵直取達固湖灣，副將李光則駐紮美崙港，鵲子埔由新城營勇固守。加禮宛援軍由達甫·瓦努率領，途中遭截擊，達甫等人戰死。撒奇萊雅這邊，大頭目古穆·巴力克與其妻伊婕·卡娜蕭在頭目會議上被推舉赴清營約降，兩人隨即在花蓮城郊的茄苳樹下被處死，事後分別被族人追尊為火神與火神太。更早把加禮宛與撒奇萊雅拉向清廷一側的，是福建陸路提督羅大春；他招撫熟番、對抗太魯閣族，使兩族一度與官府相安，直到開山部隊與營勇深入奇萊平原才生嫌隙。
peopleEn: Three men directed this war on the Qing side. Fujian Governor Wu Zan-ch'eng began by sympathising with the Kaliawan and insisted that the cause be investigated and the people first appeased; only after the Zhen-hai troops were reinforced, the fighting flared up again and a dozen men including Colonel Wen Yu-lin were killed, did he switch to pressing for armed suppression and hand the actual conduct of the campaign over to Brigadier-General Sun Kai-hua. Taiwan's brigadier-general Wu Guang-liang, who had taken over from Zhang Chi-kuang in 1876, tightened up the eastern line and first set up posts at Beinan, Shui-wei, Ma-tai-an and Wu-chuan-ch'eng; in the fighting it was he who delivered the last blow from the southern bamboo. Sun Kai-hua had planned to advance on the Kaliawan from Mei-lun Shan, but on the fifth of the ninth month, while scouting that height, his men were ambushed by the Kaliawan and several were killed, so he changed his plan and struck at Takobowan first in order to isolate the Kaliawan. On the surface he led the main body towards the Kaliawan, but in fact he sent Colonels Hu Te-hsing and Wu Li-kui, the magistrate Chu Shang-pan, Captain Li Ying and Liu Hung-shun with picked troops straight at Takobowan, while Vice-Colonel Li Kuang held the line at Mei-lun harbour and the Hsin-cheng garrison guarded Chiu-tzu-pu. The Kaliawan relief force was led by Dafu Wanu, was intercepted on the way and Dafu was killed with his companions. On the Sakizaya side the great headman Komod Pazik and his wife Icep Kanasaw were proposed at a council of headmen to go to the Qing camp to surrender; both were then executed under the banyan tree on the outskirts of Hualien, and the people afterwards came to venerate them as the Fire God and the Fire God Consort. The man who had earlier drawn the Kaliawan and the Sakizaya over to the Qing side was Luo Ta-ch'un, commander of the northern route: he had made terms with the settled tribes and fought the Truku, and for a time the two peoples lived in peace with the government, until the road-opening troops and the garrison soldiers pushed deep into the Cholan plain and the friction began.
kits: 這張卡的兵器是雷管步槍，即一八四〇年法軍制式裝備的雷管火帽前膛步槍。雷管取代火燧之後，槍機的藥盤可以封閉，火帽在雨霧中受潮仍能擊發，底火不再依賴火星；這在東臺灣多雨多霧的山地尤其要緊。槍身仍是前膛散裝藥、以布巾裹彈丸的老式結構，一名射手一分鐘只能打發一兩發，有效射程在兩三百公尺上下，但瞄準具的刻度遠到近千公尺，正面射擊的散布比舊式滑膛鳥槍小得多，密集的刺竹牆與土壘在這樣的步槍前不再是可靠的遮蔽。雷管步槍也是晚清洋務的產物：江南製造總局與福州船政局先後仿製歐洲的前膛雷管步槍，七十年代中期又開始仿製毛瑟一八七一型、沙士可一八六六型等後膛槍，臺灣鎮據此編成線槍營，軍中俗稱洋槍或快槍；抬槍、舊式鳥槍與少量格林式機關砲仍在編制之內，但槍價昂貴，線槍營的槍數有限，多集中於營與哨的骨幹。撒奇萊雅與加禮宛這邊，武器以獵刀、長矛、標槍為主，火藥極難取得，僅有少量獵槍與經漢人交易得來的舊式火槍；真正作戰用的堡壘是刺竹，部落四周沿著溪流一圈圈種植，傳記已逾六圈、樹齡逾三百年，竹牆同時是牆與拒馬；另有土壘、壕溝與溪流作障礙，火藥不足使他們更依賴地形，而不是火力的對射。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the percussion rifle, the percussion-cap muzzle-loading infantry rifle that the French army made its standard arm around 1840. Once the percussion cap replaced the flint, the pan of the lock could be closed and the cap would still strike in rain and fog, so the priming no longer depended on a spark; in the rainy, foggy mountains of eastern Taiwan that mattered more than anything else. The arm itself kept the old structure of loose powder loaded from the muzzle and a ball wrapped in a patch, so a single rifleman could fire only one or two rounds a minute, and the effective range was on the order of two to three hundred metres; but the sights were graduated up to nearly a thousand metres, and the dispersion of a shot fired at close range was far tighter than that of the old smoothbore musket, so a dense bamboo wall or an earthen rampart was no longer a reliable cover against such a rifle. The percussion rifle was also a product of the late Qing self-strengthening movement: the Kiangnan Arsenal and the Foochow Arsenal copied European percussion muzzleloaders and, in the middle of the 1870s, began copying rear-loading rifles such as the Mauser Model 1871 and the Chassepot Model 1866; the Taiwan garrison organised the Chiu-hsiang (needle gun) corps on this basis, and the men called these weapons yang-chiang, or fast guns. Heavy old smoothbores, the t'ai-ch'iang, obsolete matchlocks and a few Gatling guns were still on the establishment, but a rifle was expensive, so the number of percussion rifles in a corps was limited and they were concentrated in the battalion and detachment skeletons. On the Sakizaya and Kaliawan side the weapons were hunting knives, long spears and javelins; powder was extremely hard to come by, and there were only a few hunting guns and old muskets obtained in trade from the Chinese settlers. Their real fortification was the bamboo: rings of thorny bamboo were planted around the villages along the streams, the account runs to more than sixty rings and over three hundred years of growth, and the bamboo wall was at once a wall and a cheval de frise. Earthen ramparts, ditches and the streams themselves served as obstacles, and since powder was scarce they relied on terrain far more than on exchanges of fire.
tactics: 清軍的打法是先立據點，再分割敵人。最後一哩的路靠海路解決：新增兵員乘輪船抵達花蓮港，轉入鵲子埔、新城與美崙港三處營壘，再由嚮導帶隊翻越美崙山線進入奇萊平原。九月五日在美崙山探勘時遭到加禮宛人襲擊，清軍死傷數名，孫開華於是改變部署，改為先攻達固湖灣以孤立加禮宛社；他明面上率主力趨向加禮宛，實際遣精兵直取達固湖灣，這一手的目的，是把撒奇萊雅最堅固的堡壘與加禮宛的援兵路徑一併切斷。攻堡壘時，清軍先從其他原住民提供的情報得知刺竹林只有三道取水門，遂改由水門突入，但水門狹窄，入門即遭守軍反擊，遂改以帶火的箭矢射入竹林，把六圈以上的刺竹燒成焦炭，部落與竹牆同陷於火。頭目會議推舉古穆·巴力克赴營約降之後，清軍再攻加禮宛社一度受阻而收隊，次日清晨改為夾擊：吳光亮由南面竹林攻入，孫開華自西南方秘密渡過美崙溪，中午攻破加禮宛社的土壘，荳蘭、薄薄等社隨即歸順，太魯閣族亦加入攻擊。撒奇萊雅與加禮宛一方的戰法是靠組織與地形：部落按年齡階級編組，青年集會所是平時駐守與臨時集兵之處，頭目與長老居中調度，刺竹堡壘以三道取水門作為反擊點，溪流與濠溝切割進攻路徑，並以小米田與狩獵地為抵抗到底的依據；火燒竹林之後，固守的物質基礎與象徵同時崩塌，戰局才在幾日之內結束。
tacticsEn: The Qing method was to establish footholds first and then cut the enemy into pieces. The last stretch of the approach was solved by sea: the reinforcements came by steamer to Hualien harbour and were shifted into three camp lines at Chiu-tzu-pu, Hsin-cheng and Mei-lun harbour, and from there guides led the columns over the Mei-lun Shan ridge into the Cholan plain. On the fifth of the ninth month the scouts were ambushed at Mei-lun Shan and several soldiers were killed, so Sun Kai-hua changed his arrangement and turned to Takobowan first, to isolate the Kaliawan. In appearance he led the main body towards the Kaliawan, but in reality he sent picked troops straight at Takobowan, the object being to sever the strongest fortification of the Sakizaya and the road by which the Kaliawan could bring help. Against the fortification the Qing first learned from intelligence supplied by other indigenous people that the bamboo had only three water gates, and they changed to forcing those gates, but the gates were so narrow that men who got in were cut down at once by the defenders, so they fell back on fire arrows, shooting burning arrows into the bamboo until more than sixty rings of it burned to charcoal, and the settlement and its wall went down together in the fire. After the council of headmen offered Komod Pazik to go to the camp and surrender, an attack on the Kaliawan was checked and the troops withdrew, and at daybreak the next morning the Qing switched to a pincer: Wu Guang-liang came in through the bamboo on the south, Sun Kai-hua moved secretly from the south-west and crossed the Mei-lun River, and at noon they broke the earthen rampart of the Kaliawan settlement; Tou-lan and Po-po at once declared their submission, and the Truku joined the attack. The Sakizaya and Kaliawan method rested on organisation and terrain: villages were organised by age class, the youth assembly house served both as a place to stand guard and as a rallying point, headmen and elders directed the fighting from the centre, the bamboo fortification used its three water gates as counters, streams and ditches cut up the approach, and the millet fields and hunting grounds were the basis on which they meant to resist to the end. Once the bamboo had burned, both the material base of the defence and its symbol collapsed together, and the campaign was over within days.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。時序最為確定：清廷記載加禮宛人於六月十八日攔截清兵請撥糧食的文書，十九日分路圍攻鵲子鋪營堡，副將陳德勝受傷、參將楊玉貴陣亡；其後清廷派文官安撫，衝突平息約兩個月；加派鎮海軍後戰事再起，九月五日清軍在美崙山受挫，六日主力轉攻達固湖灣，七日再攻加禮宛社未下，八日夾擊破土壘，斬殺加禮宛人百餘名，其後荳蘭、薄薄等社歸順，加禮宛社在四面受敵之下投降。兵力方面，孫開華所部為擢勝軍一營、鎮海中營七哨、海字營四哨，加上屯紮新城鵲子埔的福靖新右營兩哨；以清制一哨約九十人、一營四哨推算，合計約一千六百人，與清方奏摺所稱「兩千餘人」同一量級，若連同隨營夫役、火夫與隨行嚮導，在場人數更高。地理方面，達固湖灣在今花蓮縣新城鄉嘉里村一帶，緊鄰美崙溪，距花蓮港十餘公里，加禮宛社在嘉里、北埔一線。防禦方面，撒奇萊雅族在部落外圍種植的刺竹，傳記已達六圈以上，樹齡超過三百年，僅留三道取水門出入。族群方面，清廷檔案記載加禮宛人分為加禮宛、竹仔林、武暖、七結仔、談仔秉、瑤歌等六社，日治時期向內政部申報的撒奇萊雅人口約千人。年月則有兩說：中文戰爭一覽把本戰役繫於一八七七年，清廷奏摺與後世戰役研究則多繫於光緒四年（一八七八）六月至九月；本卡採一八七七年，內文依實際戰鬥時序敘述，並交代一八七七年冬清軍已完成的前置部署。九月東臺灣多颱風餘雨，晨霧濃重，槍械能否在雨霧中擊發，直接影響到堡壘攻防的結果。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run as follows. The sequence is the most certain element. According to the Qing records the Kaliawan intercepted on the eighteenth day of the sixth month a document by which the soldiers asked for grain, and on the nineteenth they surrounded in several columns the camp at Chiu-tzu-pu, where Vice-Colonel Chen Te-sheng was wounded and Colonel Yang Yu-kwei was killed. Civil officials were then sent to appease the tribes and the fighting quieted for about two months; after the Zhen-hai troops were reinforced the war began again, and on the fifth of the ninth month the Qing were checked at Mei-lun Shan, on the sixth the main body turned on Takobowan, on the seventh the attack on the Kaliawan settlement failed, and on the eighth the pincer broke the earthen rampart and killed more than a hundred Kaliawan; after that Tou-lan and Po-po submitted and the Kaliawan settlement surrendered, surrounded on all sides. On strength, Sun Kai-hua's command was one battalion of the Chuo-sheng Army, seven detachments of the Chen-hai Central Camp and four detachments of the Hai-tzu Camp, together with two detachments of the Fu-ching New Right Camp at Chiu-tzu-pu in Hsin-cheng; on the Qing reckoning of about ninety men to a detachment and four detachments to a battalion, that is roughly sixteen hundred men, the same order of magnitude as the two thousand odd men claimed in the memorial, and the number actually on the ground was higher once porters, camp servants and guides were counted. Geographically Takobowan lay in what is now Jiali Village, Hsin-cheng Township, Hualien County, right beside the Mei-lun River and a dozen-odd kilometres from Hualien harbour, with the Kaliawan settlement on the Jiali and Pei-pu line. On defences, the thorny bamboo planted around the Sakizaya villages is said to have reached more than sixty rings with a growth of over three hundred years, and only three water gates were left for entry and exit. On the peoples, the Qing archives record the Kaliawan as six communities, Chia-lien, Chu-tzu-lin, Wu-nuan, Chi-chieh-tzu, Tan-tzu-ping and Yao-ko, and the population the Sakizaya reported to the Interior Ministry under Japanese rule was about a thousand. As to the year there are two reckonings: Chinese lists of wars date this campaign to 1877, while the Qing memorials and later studies mostly place it between June and September of the fourth year of Guangxu, 1878. This card takes 1877; the text follows the actual order of the fighting and sets out the deployment the Qing had already completed in the winter of 1877. The ninth month in eastern Taiwan carries the tail of the typhoons, and the morning fog was heavy, so whether a musket would still go off in rain and fog directly affected how the assault on the fortifications went.
cause: 這場戰爭的起因，是清廷在後山推行開山撫番，把軍隊與漢人墾戶一路推入奇萊平原。牡丹社事件之後，欽差大臣沈葆楨提出開山與撫番的雙軌經營：在後山設南、中兩路理番同知，設招墾局招募漢人開墾，佈署軍隊以宣示管轄權。這套辦法直接侵犯原住民的獵場與耕地，也把日常買賣糾紛帶進了營壘。開山初期，清廷對加禮宛與撒奇萊雅其實是拉攏的：北路統領羅大春一面對付太魯閣族，一面招撫熟番，兩族一度相安，還曾聯手北攻；直到營勇進駐、墾戶侵入、界線模糊，關係才逐漸惡化。一八七六年十一月，加禮宛人聯合荳蘭與木瓜等社夜襲營堡，福建巡撫丁日昌聞訊親自渡臺查辦，事件平定後改派吳光亮接掌臺灣總兵，著手整飭東路軍紀。真正引爆的是一八七七年冬到翌年之間的日常衝突：營勇到部落買糧，價錢與秤量起了爭執；營勇又凌辱部落婦女，加禮宛人聚集到營裡理論，肇事者被隱匿，理論者反被殺害，於是兩族下定反清的決心。六月十八日攔截請撥糧食的文書、十九日圍攻鵲子鋪營堡、參將楊玉貴陣亡，使清廷的安撫手段失效；加派鎮海軍反而激化對抗，最後促使吳贊誠放棄招撫，改用武力。
causeEn: The war came out of the Qing drive to open roads and pacify the tribes in the eastern mountains, which pushed soldiers and Han settlers deeper and deeper into the Cholan plain. After the Mudan community incident the imperial commissioner Shen Bao-zhen proposed managing the rear mountains on two tracks at once, opening roads and pacifying the tribes: setting up civil commissioners for native affairs on the southern and central routes, opening a settlement office to recruit Han farmers, and stationing troops to make the jurisdiction visible. The scheme cut directly into the hunting grounds and fields of the indigenous people and carried everyday quarrels over trade into the camps. In the early days of road-opening the Qing were in fact courting the Kaliawan and the Sakizaya: Luo Ta-ch'un, commander of the northern route, fought the Truku on one side and made terms with the settled tribes on the other, and for a time the two peoples lived quietly with the government and even joined in attacks to the north. It was only when the garrison soldiers moved in, the settlers followed and the boundary lines blurred that relations steadily worsened. In November 1876 the Kaliawan, with the Tou-lan and Mu-kua communities, attacked a barracks by night; Fujian governor Ting Ri-chang heard of it and came across to the island himself to deal with the matter, and after the incident was settled he replaced Zhang Chi-kuang with Wu Guang-liang as Taiwan's brigadier-general in order to straighten out the eastern army. What really set the powder dry were the everyday clashes between the winter of 1877 and the following year: soldiers buying grain at the villages quarrelled over price and weight, and soldiers also mistreated the women of the tribes; the Kaliawan gathered to reason with the soldiers, the offender was hidden and those who came to reason were killed instead, and from that point both peoples resolved to resist. The interception of the grain document on the eighteenth of the sixth month, the attack on the camp at Chiu-tzu-pu on the nineteenth and the death of Colonel Yang Yu-kwei made the Qing policy of pacification fail; reinforcing with the Zhen-hai troops only sharpened the resistance, and in the end it was Wu Zan-ch'eng who gave up conciliation and chose force.
impact: 這場戰役是清廷在東臺灣由防守轉入實控的分水嶺。奇萊平原中部原本是撒奇萊雅族最堅固的根據地，達固湖灣陷落、加禮宛社投降之後，花蓮港以北的後山不再有能與清軍對抗的整片部落，開山撫番在東路的軍事目標宣告完成，屯駐、招墾與道路同時往內陸推進。族群版圖也從此重排：協助清軍並分得地盤的七腳川社阿美族一舉成為奇萊平原最大勢力，直到日治時期的七腳川事件後才式微；撒奇萊雅與噶瑪蘭兩族的聚落則被清除，幸存者逃入縱谷與東海岸山區，藏身阿美族之中，族群名稱與祭儀在整整一個世紀裡幾近失傳，直到二〇〇六年花蓮市國福部落才重辦火神祭，二〇〇九年兩族在加禮宛大社紀念碑前舉行埋石立約，二〇一四年撒奇萊雅族完成正名，成為臺灣第十三個原住民族。對清廷而言，這也是以番制番手法的示範：生番被徵用為攻擊同族的先鋒，事後由官府重新劃分獵場與番社的行政地位。對武器史而言，一八七〇年代後期臺灣的槍械體系正處在雷管前膛槍與後膛槍交接的節點，線槍營這類以雷管步槍為骨干的編制，把膛線、瞄準與火帽可靠性一併帶進了山區，這也是為何一場以竹牆與土壘為依託的抵抗，在幾日之間被解決。
impactEn: This campaign was the watershed at which the Qing in eastern Taiwan moved from holding ground to actually governing it. The middle of the Cholan plain had been the strongest base of the Sakizaya, and once Takobowan fell and the Kaliawan settlement surrendered there was no longer any whole community north of Hualien harbour able to face the Qing army; the military aim of the road-opening and pacification policy in the east was declared achieved, and garrisons, settlement and roads all advanced inland together. The ethnic map was rearranged as well. The Seven-Leg Amis, who had assisted the Qing and gained land in the process, became the largest power on the Cholan plain and did not decline again until the Chiu-chiao-chuan incident under Japanese rule. The settlements of the Sakizaya and the Kavalan were cleared away, the survivors fled into the longitudinal valley and the coastal mountains and hid among the Amis, and the names and rituals of the two peoples came close to being lost for a full century: the Fire God festival was revived at Kuo-fu Village in Hualien City only in 2006, the two peoples performed the rite of burying a stone and pledging oath before the Kaliawan memorial stele in 2009, and the Sakizaya were formally recognised as the thirteenth indigenous people of Taiwan in 2014. For the Qing the campaign was also a demonstration of the method of using one tribe to control another: indigenous people were conscripted as the vanguard against their own kin, and the government afterwards redistributed hunting grounds and redefined the administrative status of the tribal communities. For the history of weapons, the Taiwanese arms system of the late 1870s stood exactly at the point of transition from percussion muzzleloaders to rear-loading rifles; corps such as the Chiu-hsiang, built around percussion rifles, carried rifling, proper sights and the reliability of the cap into the mountains, and that is why a resistance founded on bamboo walls and earthen ramparts was settled within a matter of days.
result: 九月六日，達固湖灣的刺竹林在火攻下燒成焦炭，堡壘與屋舍同陷，頭目會議推舉大頭目古穆·巴力克與其妻伊婕·卡娜蕭赴清營約降，兩人卻在花蓮城郊的茄苳樹下被處死，頭目夫人更被夾在剖成兩半的巨木之間，踏斃而死，族人至今以火神與火神太追祀這對夫妻。九月七日清軍再攻加禮宛社，因路況惡劣、雜草叢生而收隊回營。次日清晨，吳光亮由南面竹林攻入，孫開華自西南方渡過美崙溪，兩面夾擊之下，午時攻破加禮宛社的土壘，斬殺百餘名，餘眾逃散；荳蘭、薄薄等社隨即表示順服，太魯閣族也加入對加禮宛社的攻擊，加禮宛社在四面受敵之下投降。戰後清軍佔領達固湖灣全土，加禮宛社一帶的抵抗亦告終結，七腳川社阿美族以協功地位取代兩族成為奇萊平原的主導者，撒奇萊雅與噶瑪蘭兩族的聚落則在奇萊平原上消失，幸存者改以阿美族的身分藏身於縱谷與東海岸山地。這一戰的結果，是清廷在東臺灣第一次以不到三千人的部隊，徹底解決了一整片平原上的抵抗，也是清季臺灣「開山撫番」由安撫手段轉為武力手段的分水嶺。
resultEn: On the sixth of the ninth month the bamboo at Takobowan burned to charcoal under the fire arrows, and the fortification and the houses went down with it. The council of headmen proposed the great headman Komod Pazik and his wife Icep Kanasaw to go to the Qing camp to surrender, and both were instead executed under the banyan tree on the outskirts of Hualien; the headman's wife was shut between the two halves of a great tree that had been split and trodden to death, and the people still honour the pair as the Fire God and the Fire God Consort. On the seventh the Qing attacked the Kaliawan settlement again and withdrew to their camp, the roads being bad and the grass chest high. At daybreak the next morning Wu Guang-liang came in through the bamboo on the south and Sun Kai-hua crossed the Mei-lun River from the south-west, and at noon the earthen rampart of the Kaliawan settlement was broken and more than a hundred were killed while the rest scattered. Tou-lan and Po-po at once declared their submission, the Truku joined the attack on the Kaliawan settlement, and the Kaliawan surrendered, surrounded on all sides. Afterwards the Qing occupied the whole of Takobowan and the resistance in the Kaliawan area was over; the Seven-Leg Amis took the place of the two peoples as the dominant power on the Cholan plain by right of their service, and the settlements of the Sakizaya and the Kavalan disappeared from the plain, the survivors hiding in the valley and the coastal mountains in the guise of Amis. The upshot was that the Qing, with a force of fewer than three thousand men, had settled once and for all the resistance of an entire plain in eastern Taiwan, and the turn of the late Qing policy of opening roads and pacifying the tribes in Taiwan from means of conciliation to means of force dates from this campaign.
